#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Create a Project Kickoff Meeting event for next Monday 10 AM - 12 PM as ICS."""
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
import uuid

# --- Compute next Monday (strictly after today) ---
TZ_NAME = "America/New_York"
try:
    import pytz
    TZ = pytz.timezone(TZ_NAME)
    tz_available = True
except Exception:
    TZ = None
    tz_available = False

if tz_available:
    today = datetime.now(TZ).date()
else:
    today = datetime.now().date()

days_ahead = (0 - today.weekday()) % 7
if days_ahead == 0:
    days_ahead = 7
next_monday = today + timedelta(days=days_ahead)

start_dt = datetime(next_monday.year, next_monday.month, next_monday.day, 10, 0)
end_dt = datetime(next_monday.year, next_monday.month, next_monday.day, 12, 0)

if tz_available:
    start_local = TZ.localize(start_dt)
    end_local = TZ.localize(end_dt)
else:
    start_local = start_dt
    end_local = end_dt

uid = f"{uuid.uuid4()}@calendar-skill.local"
stamp = datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ") if not tz_available else datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ")

OUT = "project_kickoff.ics"

try:
    from icalendar import Calendar, Event, Alarm

    cal = Calendar()
    cal.add("prodid", "-//Calendar Skill//Project Kickoff//EN")
    cal.add("version", "2.0")
    cal.add("calscale", "GREGORIAN")

    event = Event()
    event.add("uid", uid)
    event.add("dtstamp", datetime.utcnow())
    event.add("summary", "Project Kickoff Meeting")
    event.add("description", "Kickoff meeting for the new project.")
    event.add("dtstart", start_local)
    event.add("dtend", end_local)
    event.add("status", "CONFIRMED")
    event.add("transp", "OPAQUE")

    alarm = Alarm()
    alarm.add("action", "DISPLAY")
    alarm.add("description", "Project Kickoff Meeting starts in 15 minutes")
    alarm.add("trigger", timedelta(minutes=-15))
    event.add_component(alarm)

    cal.add_component(event)

    with open(OUT, "wb") as f:
        f.write(cal.to_ical())

    # Validate by parsing back
    with open(OUT, "rb") as f:
        parsed = Calendar.from_ical(f.read())
    for comp in parsed.walk():
        if comp.name == "VEVENT":
            print("VALIDATION: OK (parsed with icalendar)")
            print("Summary:", comp.get("summary"))
            print("Start:", comp.get("dtstart").dt)
            print("End:", comp.get("dtend").dt)
            print("Status:", comp.get("status"))
            print("UID:", comp.get("uid"))
except ImportError:
    # Fallback: hand-write the ICS file
    start_fmt = start_local.strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%S")
    end_fmt = end_local.strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%S")
    if tz_available:
        dtstart = f"DTSTART;TZID={TZ_NAME}:{start_fmt}"
        dtend = f"DTEND;TZID={TZ_NAME}:{end_fmt}"
    else:
        dtstart = f"DTSTART:{start_fmt}"
        dtend = f"DTEND:{end_fmt}"
    ics = "\r\n".join([
        "BEGIN:VCALENDAR",
        "VERSION:2.0",
        "PRODID:-//Calendar Skill//Project Kickoff//EN",
        "CALSCALE:GREGORIAN",
        "BEGIN:VEVENT",
        f"UID:{uid}",
        f"DTSTAMP:{stamp}",
        "SUMMARY:Project Kickoff Meeting",
        "DESCRIPTION:Kickoff meeting for the new project.",
        dtstart,
        dtend,
        "STATUS:CONFIRMED",
        "TRANSP:OPAQUE",
        "BEGIN:VALARM",
        "ACTION:DISPLAY",
        "DESCRIPTION:Project Kickoff Meeting starts in 15 minutes",
        "TRIGGER:-PT15M",
        "END:VALARM",
        "END:VEVENT",
        "END:VCALENDAR",
        "",
    ])
    with open(OUT, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(ics)
    # Simple structural validation
    assert "BEGIN:VCALENDAR" in ics and "END:VCALENDAR" in ics
    assert "BEGIN:VEVENT" in ics and "END:VEVENT" in ics
    assert "UID:" in ics and "DTSTAMP:" in ics and "DTSTART" in ics and "DTEND" in ics
    print("VALIDATION: OK (manual structural check, icalendar not installed)")
    print("Summary: Project Kickoff Meeting")
    print("Start:", start_local)
    print("End:", end_local)
    print("UID:", uid)

print("File written:", OUT)
